name: Breitspur
tagline: The versions that should have existed.
description: Breitspur is a design studio for German cars.  Each concept pushes the factory's own design language one step further than the factory dared.

manifesto.lead: Every great car had a sharper version that never made it out of the design studio.  Breitspur draws those cars.
manifesto.body: We take the factory's own design language and push it one step further than they dared.  Truer stance, wider track, flares surfaced as if they came off the original line.  Designed by a trained car designer, one car at a time.

founder.quote: Car companies build these raw, emotional things that never get to see the streets.  I want people to actually get to experience them.
founder.name: Nick DiLoreto
founder.bio: Trained as a car designer.  Started at Volvo.  Now an industrial design leader for a major consumer hardware brand.

services.title: Commission a concept
services.body: Send us your car.  We draw it back as the version that should have existed: proportions, stance, flares, wheels and color, finished as a gallery plate you can frame or build from.
details: Design notes on surfacing, wheels and color

services.title: Design consulting
services.body: Surfacing, body kits, wheels and brand direction for shops and makers who want the forms right.  The highlights, radii and flares are where most aftermarket design falls apart.  That is where we spend our time.
details: Body kit and flare design review

shop.teaser: Wheels, parts and apparel to follow.
shop.intro: Wheels and parts drawn by the studio.  Every wheel is CNC machined to order from forged aluminum, one set at a time, for one car.  Nothing is on sale yet.  Register interest and you hear first.

categories.title: Wheels
categories.body: Drawn for the cars in the collection.  Machined to order for the car you drive.

categories.title: Carbon parts
categories.body: Splitters, lips, ducktails and roofs in exposed carbon.

categories.title: Body kits
categories.body: Flares and full kits, surfaced to follow the original lines.

process.title: Register interest
process.body: Tell us your car, size and finish.  It commits you to nothing, and the list hears first when build slots open.

process.title: Fitment
process.body: We confirm your measurements, brakes and stance with you before a single blank is cut.

process.title: Machined for your car
process.body: Your set is CNC machined from forged blanks, finished, numbered and shipped.  One set at a time.

bespoke.label: MADE FOR ONE CAR
bespoke.lead: Every set is machined for one car.  Yours.
bespoke.body: There is no warehouse and no catalog size.  Each wheel starts as a forged 6061-T6 aluminum blank and is CNC machined to order, one set at a time, to the exact fitment of the car it is going on.

items.title: Width and offset
items.body: Set to your arches, your tires and the stance you want, not the nearest size on a shelf.

items.title: Bolt pattern and center bore
items.body: Machined to your hub, so the wheel centers on the car without adapters or rings.

items.title: Brake clearance
items.body: Checked against your calipers before cutting, big brake kits included.

items.title: Finish
items.body: From the studio palette, or matched to your car.

items.title: Numbered
items.body: Every set carries its own serial number, machined into the wheel.

items.title: Build sheet
items.body: Your set ships with its build sheet: your car, your specification and a drawing signed by the designer.

sheet: 15 x 8 in front, 15 x 9 in rear

privacy.intro: Breitspur is a small, independent studio.  We collect as little as we can, we never sell it, and you can ask us to delete it at any time.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: Inquiries: if you send the inquiry form, we keep your name, email address, your car and your message.  Netlify, our web host, receives and stores the form for us.

Shop interest: if you register interest in a product or sign up for shop updates, we keep your name, email address, your car and the answers you chose, such as size, finish and budget.  Netlify stores these for us too.
Server logs: like any web host, Netlify records basic request data such as IP address, browser type and the pages requested.  We use it only to keep the site running and secure.
We do not run analytics, ad trackers or user accounts, and we set no cookies of our own.

sections.heading: How we use it
body: We use your details to reply to your inquiry and, if we work together, to deliver the project.  If you registered interest in a product, we email you about that product only, and use the answers in aggregate to decide what to make.  We send studio news only if you ticked the box for it.  We never sell, rent or trade your details.

sections.heading: Your choices
body: Wherever you live, you can ask what we hold about you, have it corrected, or have it deleted.  Every product email has an unsubscribe link, or write to us through the inquiry form and we will act within 30 days.

sections.heading: Changes
body: If this policy changes, we will update the date at the top of this page.
